summary: Frontend-only test of the cameo clip fix on /meet/a5yxsmhb, /h/a5yxsmhb and the share reveal, at 390x844 and 1280x800, in Chromium AND WebKit. Playwright WebKit 2248 plus its OS dependencies were installed with `playwright install webkit` and `install-deps webkit`. PASS: [data-testid=opening-cameo] measures exactly 25%/17.18%/49.4%/66.15% of the art box (1280: 252.9x316.75 at 192,242.8; 390: 168.9x211.6). Its computed clip-path and -webkit-clip-path are ellipse(50% 50% at 50% 50%), with border-radius 50% and overflow hidden, in both engines. The new figure, the band strips and the band text are all clipped inside the opening; no wicker of the NEW figure reaches the light ring and nothing of him is behind or below the ribbon. All band glyphs render: 22/22, 24/24 and 10/10 chars have non-zero extents in both engines. 'meet Hollis' (ribbon-name) is fully visible below the opening (390: ribbon top 364 vs opening bottom 353.5). Emotions: 3 taps on face-tap-target gave blush, hearts, kiss on both pages, in both browsers and at both widths. There were 0 page errors. The share reveal's server card (blob) has the figure inside the card oval. The forced client fallback (card.jpg aborted) uses card-husband with clip-path ellipse(50% 50%) in both engines and is also clean. FAIL: the art's OLD content shows between the new opening and the pale ring, so the requirement 'no dark crescent or old-figure remnants between the ring and the portrait' is NOT met, in both engines and at both widths. Before this fix the oversized figure covered it; now that he is clipped, it shows.

ui_bugs.issue: The art's old inner window (dark grey-green mist, #5E6B59-ish, with light rays) and the old wicker figure (dark brown bands and wicker body) are drawn in meet-cameo.svg and extend beyond the new opening ellipse (cx 414.5, cy 392, rx 206, ry 258). They show as: (1) dark crescents at the upper-left and upper-right between the opening and the pale ring, plus a faint light-ray remnant at the top-left; (2) dark brown band ends with wicker texture beside his lower shoulders, at left and right, just above the ribbon; (3) a gold/wicker sliver along the bottom edge of the opening just above the ribbon. Pixel scan (i17_ring_scan.py) of a thin band just outside the opening (d 1.015-1.08) at 1280: Chromium 45.7% dark pixels, WebKit 43.4%. They are spread over all 6 regions: top-L/R about 1000 px each, mid about 850, bottom about 1100. The same appears at 390 and on /h/a5yxsmhb, because both pages use the same component.

In WebKit, textPath with startOffset=50%, text-anchor=middle and textLength/lengthAdjust=spacingAndGlyphs is NOT centred. At 1280 line 0 is about 7px left of centre and line 1 ('VOICE NOTES · ADVENTURES') is about 12px left, so 'VOICE' crowds the left end of the strip. At 390 the offsets are about 5px and 10px. Chromium is centred (line centre 318.4 vs opening centre 318.5). All letters remain readable and inside the opening.

issues: When the server card fails, the html-to-image fallback in WebKit takes more than 7s and under 20s; during that time the card area is empty. It renders correctly at 20s. This is slow but not broken. Consider a spinner or 'weaving card…' placeholder.

action_items: HIGH: Hide the art's old window and old figure outside the new opening. Option A: edit /public/art/meet-cameo.svg to remove the old inner-window mist, the light rays and the old wicker figure and bands, and fill that area with the pale ring colour. Option B: in Face.jsx (cameo), render an art-box SVG under the opening with an even-odd path whose outer contour is the art's old window bounds (slightly larger) and whose hole is the opening ellipse (414.5,392,206,258), filled with the pale ring colour. Check the result with i17_zoom.py and the artonly/outline screenshots, then i17_ring_scan.py; the dark ratio should be near 0.
MEDIUM: Fix WebKit band centring. Option 1: drop textAnchor=middle and use startOffset = (pathLen - textLength)/2 with text-anchor start. Option 2: only set textLength when natural > cap.
critical_code_review_comments: Face.jsx: SPOTS.cameo.clip/bg/fig are still dead for cameo, because the open branch is used.

Face.jsx: the opening's gradient ends in #5E6B59 at its edge. This dark rim blends with the art's leftover dark window and makes the crescent look thicker. A lighter outer stop would also soften the edge.
Face.jsx: StillHusband and the cameo duplicate the figure geometry (-11%/122%/-10%). Extract it to a constant.

success_rate.frontend: about 75%. Clip, band text, ribbon, emotions and share card pass. The 'no remnants between ring and portrait' check fails in both engines.

context_for_next_testing_agent: WebKit is now installed in /pw-browsers (webkit-2248) together with its OS deps. Run the scripts with /opt/plugins-venv/bin/python, because the system python has no playwright. Usage: i17_cameo_clip.py <path> <tag> [chromium,webkit] writes i17_<tag>_<browser>_<w>.png; it uses JS scrollIntoView because WebKit's scroll_into_view_if_needed times out on the animated element. i17_zoom.py <browser> writes the zoom, artonly and outline images at 1280 with DPR 2. i17_ring_scan.py <zoom.png> 1.08 gives the dark-pixel ratio just outside the opening. i17_reveal.py tests the server card and the forced client fallback; WebKit needs about 20s for the fallback.
